brief: Why sunscreen is the only product that matters — and how to pick one.

slots.author: Dr. Elena Voss
slots.title: PREVENTION FIRST
slots.body: Sunscreen is the single most effective anti-aging product available. It blocks the ultraviolet radiation responsible for eighty percent of visible skin aging. No serum can repair damage that never occurs.

slots.author: Dr. Elena Voss
slots.title: KNOW YOUR RAYS
slots.body: UVA rays penetrate deep and age your skin silently. UVB burns the surface and causes lasting cellular harm. Broad-spectrum filters shield against both daily threats.

slots.author: Dr. Elena Voss
slots.title: DECODE THE SPF
slots.body: The number indicates protection level against burning UVB rays. SPF thirty blocks ninety-seven percent when applied generously. Higher numbers offer marginally more but require the same diligent reapplication.

slots.author: Dr. Elena Voss
slots.title: PICK YOUR FILTER
slots.body: Mineral formulas sit on the skin and reflect light with zinc. Chemical filters absorb rays and feel weightless under makeup. Choose the texture you will wear every single morning.

slots.author: Dr. Elena Voss
slots.title: APPLY ENOUGH
slots.body: Most people use only half the sunscreen they actually need. A full teaspoon for the face ensures the labeled protection level. Reapply every two hours when exposed to daylight.

slots.author: Dr. Elena Voss
slots.title: MAKE IT DAILY
slots.body: Clouds and windows do not block aging UVA rays. Consistent morning application preserves collagen and maintains an even tone. Consider it the final non-negotiable step in your ritual.

slots.author: Dr. Elena Voss
slots.headline: PROTECT YOUR GLOW
slots.body: Ready to find your perfect SPF? Follow for more expert guidance and curated recommendations.
